verdict.rationale: The SOS business-entities forms page says all business forms can be submitted by mail or in person, which implies paper forms are published on the public forms page. The evidence never explicitly says the forms or their instructions can be downloaded, or that no account is needed; the new User Access requirement applies to online Statement of Information filing, not to obtaining forms. missing for 10: explicit statement that form PDFs are downloadable, evidence that instructions are published alongside the forms, confirmation that no account is required, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account

citations.quote: All business forms can be submitted by mail or in person.
